title: A part lookup result from the shared list shows Part Library as its source
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], Admin role.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: [PN-A] (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LOOKSRC-01) stocked at [Loc-1] with quantity 5; an open work order [WO-1] for a ZZAUTOTEST customer with one line.

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. Create [PN-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL lookup source" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LOOKSRC-01 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [PN-A] = the part number you typed.
  3. Create an open work order: in the top bar click Work Orders, click New, and in the New Work Order dialog use the Add button beside Customer to create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL lookup source customer") and the Add button beside Asset to create an asset for it (e.g. unit "ZZAUTOTEST PL lookup source-UNIT"); click Save, and click Create if a confirmation appears. [WO-1] = the work order number shown.
  4. On [WO-1] click New Line, type a Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL lookup source line"), and click Save & Close.
  5. Check the setup worked: [WO-1] is open with one line and [PN-A] is on the Active tab with quantity 5.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  2. Open [WO-1].
  3. On the [WO-1] line, click + Add Part in its Parts row.
  4. In New Part Request, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LOOKSRC in Part Number.
  5. Read the results offered for [PN-A].
  6. Close the dialog without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: [PN-A] is offered twice: once from inventory, whose second line reads "Inventory Qty: 5" with its unit, and once from the shared list, whose second line reads "Part Library". No result reads "Catalog".
